name: Learnable Normal Estimation with Pseudo-Normal Supervision
aliases: Learnable Unit Normal with Depth Gradient Supervision
definition: Assigns each Gaussian a learnable unit normal to avoid noise and inconsistency from gradient-based normals. Predictions are splatted and supervised against pseudo-normals derived from expected depth.
summary: Learnable Normal Estimation with Pseudo-Normal Supervision assigns learnable unit normals to 3D Gaussians, optimizing them against depth-derived pseudo-normals to prevent overfitting to lighting conditions.
